hip_knee_replacement.label: Hip and knee joint replacement
hip_knee_replacement.notes: DRG 469 = with major complication, 470 = without. No mortality measure published for this condition; the quality signal is the complication rate.

heart_failure.label: Heart failure
heart_failure.notes: DRG 291 = with MCC, 292 = with CC. NY CY2024 has no DRG 293.

pneumonia.label: Pneumonia
pneumonia.notes: DRG 193 = with MCC, 194 = with CC, 195 = without.

heart_attack.label: Heart attack (acute myocardial infarction)
heart_attack.notes: DRGs 280-282 are discharged alive; 283-285 (expired) are not included.

copd.label: COPD
copd.notes: DRG 190 = with MCC, 191 = with CC, 192 = without.

stroke.label: Stroke
stroke.notes: No HRRP readmission measure exists for stroke. DRGs 061-062 (ischemic with thrombolytic) and 064-066 (hemorrhage/infarction).

sepsis.label: Sepsis
sepsis.notes: No condition-specific quality measure is published; cost only.
